title: Embodied voice exercises
description: Unscored exercises: say one short sound while conveying a feeling dealt from data/emotions.json, with a gentle live view of pitch and resonance and questions to notice what the body did. Shown in file order.

id.description: Stable id starting with em-. Never change or reuse one that has shipped.

cue.description: Short name on the exercise card.

sub.description: A few words under the name on the card.

say.description: The sound to say, as shown in the prompt (for example "uwu").

oneOf.description: A step that depends on the training goal.

steps.description: Steps shown in order. Use an object with feminine and masculine for a step that differs by goal.

reflect.description: Questions to notice what changed. One is shown after each try, in turn.
